title: Grounds on Which a Northbeam Returns and Restocking Restocking Fee Is Charged or Relieved
content:
*The restocking fee is the schedule's percentage of the line price, then raised to the schedule's minimum and cut to the schedule's cap, and rounded to the cent.* That clause is **no longer in force**: it has been superseded for Northbeam Returns and Restocking by the current basis on which the fee is worked out. The clauses set out below stand as the grounds in force.

**Clause 1 — when a fee may be charged or relieved at all.** A restocking fee is charged or waived only while the authorisation stands inspected or settled.

**Clause 2 — no fee where the retailer's own failure brought the item back.** No restocking fee is charged where the item is graded defective on arrival or not as described, or where the retailer shipped the wrong item, because the fee pays for putting saleable stock back.

**Clause 3 — an activated device.** A device already activated on a network carries the schedule's flat activated device fee instead of a percentage fee, and the two are never charged together.

**Clause 4 — a Circle member's relief.** Where the schedule waives the fee for a Circle member the waiver is recorded with the membership as its reason, and *the member's tier waiver percentage is applied to whatever fee is left where the schedule does not waive it outright* — that part of the clause is **no longer in force**, superseded by the current basis on which the membership's relief is worked out.

**Clause 5 — goodwill.** A fee waived as goodwill is recorded as goodwill and does not change what the schedule charges the next time.

## The state the authorisation must stand in

The status is read from the return authorisation record identified by its own reference number, together with the grade standing on it, and it is read before the fee is charged or the waiver recorded. Only two statuses admit either entry.

| Status of the authorisation | May a fee be charged or waived? |
| --- | --- |
| requested, authorized, in transit, received | no |
| inspected | yes |
| settled | yes |
| denied, withdrawn | no |

## Points of judgement on the grounds in force

**Two grades and one reason carry no fee.** Defective on arrival and not as described are grades; the wrong item having been shipped is a matter of what the retailer did. Any of the three means no restocking fee, on the ground that the fee pays for putting saleable stock back and there is nothing of the customer's doing to pay for.

**A percentage fee and a device fee are never charged together.** Where the schedule publishes a flat activated device fee, that fee stands in place of the percentage fee.

**Goodwill is recorded as goodwill.** A fee relieved as a gesture is recorded on that ground, and it does not change what the schedule charges on the next return.
